title: Dot Vote
description: After a brainstorm, the room chooses: each person spreads a few dots across the ideas (two on one idea means "this one, really"), sends them, and watches the ideas rank themselves as everyone's dots come in. It pairs with `TextWall` or `QuestionBoard` for…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/dot-vote

Installed to `components/ui/games/dot-vote.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/dot-vote';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/dot-vote

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
